name: Weakness, Superior
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, inquisitor 5, paladin 4, psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner/unchained summoner 5, witch 5
Duration 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as weakness except as noted above and the resistance bonus to saves is increased to +6.
